cohort: The study included women who presented with eclampsia or developed a new episode of eclampsia during their hospital stay.
finding: Inadequate prenatal care, low socioeconomic level, and inadequate education are major contributors to eclampsia, which is a significant cause of maternal, fetal, and neonatal morbidity and mortality.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was the mode of delivery in 77.27% of cases, primarily due to an unfavourable cervix.
